user_saw: `openclaw path set` could report success while silently deleting unrelated Markdown metadata and comments.
summary: Markdown edits now patch the selected source range and preserve untouched bytes in both the body and frontmatter.
reasoning: The oldest available source already rebuilt the entire document from an index that omitted YAML continuation lines and standalone comments. I checked that #140150 retained that reconstruction when it renamed the renderer. The path history stopped at the July 1 shallow boundary, so I could not verify whether Markdown editing shipped with this behavior or acquired it earlier.
